_rule: One prebuilt voice per character, never reused by another character (owner 2026-09-30). status: approved | audition.

fadyme.style: A young adult woman in her early twenties speaking Japanese: light, controlled alto; soft, courteous and precise; quiet warmth and tiredness under the politeness; she hides pain by speaking a little more evenly. Never theatrical, never childish.
fadyme.inner_voice_style: Inner voice: close to the microphone, very quiet, almost a breath.
fadyme.history: 2026-09-30: Sadachbia auditioned (11 lines), owner switched to Sulafat. Sadachbia never shipped for any character.
fadyme.method: One call per scene with the fixed style, split into lines, level-matched to -20 dB; 2-3 takes per line, keep the take closest to the reference pitch.
